dedupe_keys.name: crige paca org landslide and ground movement hazard datasets

description: crige-paca.org: landslide and ground movement hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by crige-paca.org. Coverage: the area served by crige-paca.org. The listing groups 11 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about landslide and ground movement hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Aléa coulée de boue au 1/100 000e - Région PACA; Aléa chute de blocs au 1/100 000e - Région PACA; Aléa glissement de terrain au 1/100 000e - Région PACA; Aléa chute de blocs au 1/25 000e - Bassin de la Roya. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
